# Selvi Framework — Indeks Dokumentasi untuk Agen AI

> Selvi adalah micro-framework PHP (>= 8.1) untuk membangun API: routing,
> dependency injection, response/JSON, view, model berbasis attribute, dan
> lapisan database MySQL/MariaDB (query builder, DDL, migrasi, seeder).
> Semua halaman berbahasa Indonesia, sementara identifier dan pesan error
> mengikuti source code.

- Versi yang berlaku: **Selvi 3.x** (`mochrira/selvi-framework`, PHP >= 8.1).
- Setiap halaman punya YAML front matter: `id`, `title`, `type`, `class`
  (khusus referensi), `tags`, `prerequisites`, `verified`, `applies_to`.
- Signature kanonik ada di `99-referensi/`; halaman bab hanya contoh.
- Bagian **Status verifikasi** adalah catatan pengujian, bukan spesifikasi API.
- Peta dokumentasi lengkap: [README.md](README.md).

## Cara memotong (chunking)

- `01-memulai/`, `02-dto/`, dan `03-database/`: potong per heading `##`.
- `99-referensi/`: potong per heading `###` — satu method satu chunk.
- Sertakan hierarki heading (`H1` → `H2` → `H3`) sebagai metadata chunk.
- Heading method referensi sudah memuat nama kelas
  (mis. `AlterBlueprint::dropForeign($name)`), jadi tetap jelas tanpa halaman
  induk.

## Panduan

- [Instalasi](01-memulai/01-instalasi.md) — `id: instalasi`. Composer,
  `index.php`, `.htaccess`, autoload, uji pertama.
- [Response](01-memulai/02-response.md) — `id: response`. `response()`,
  `jsonResponse()`, view, status code, header `Content-Type`.
- [Request](01-memulai/03-request.md) — `id: request`. Query string, body JSON,
  form, header, cookie.
- [Controller](01-memulai/04-controller.md) — `id: controller`. Callback
  `Kelas@method`, parameter route, dependency injection, middleware.
- [Data Object (DTO)](02-dto/01-data-object.md) — `id: data-object`.
  `DataObject::of()`, `toArray()`, `DataProperty`, kunci sumber vs nama
  properti, `optional`.
- [Properti Bersarang](02-dto/02-properti-nested.md) — `id: data-object-nested`.
  `DataProperty(prefix: ...)`, kunci `{prefix}__{name}`, nesting dua tingkat,
  objek bersarang langsung, nullable vs `optional`.
- [Cast dan Serialize](02-dto/03-cast-dan-serialize.md) —
  `id: data-object-cast-serialize`. Cast bawaan, `ArrayCast`, `DateTimeCast`,
  `cast`, `serialize`, nilai `null`.
- [Koneksi Database](03-database/01-koneksi.md) — `id: database-koneksi`.
  `Manager::add()`, `.ENV`, `DB` facade, query mentah, transaksi, multi-koneksi,
  bentuk `DatabaseException`.
- [Skema Tabel](03-database/02-skema-tabel.md) — `id: database-skema-tabel`.
  `create()`, tipe kolom, modifier, `alter()` (index, primary key, foreign key),
  `drop()`, `rename()`, `truncate()`.
- [Membaca Data](03-database/03-membaca-data.md) — `id: database-membaca-data`.
  `DB::table()`, `select()`, bentuk `where`, `join`, `group`, `order`,
  `limit`/`offset`, `getSql()`, `rows()`/`row()`/`num_rows()`.
- [Menulis Data](03-database/04-menulis-data.md) — `id: database-menulis-data`.
  `insert()` single/multi, `update()`/`delete()` dengan pengaman `WHERE`,
  transaksi manual.
- [Migrasi](03-database/05-migrasi.md) — `id: database-migrasi`.
  `Migration::add()`, kontrak file, perintah `db:migrate`, `--step`/`--all`,
  tabel `_migration`, skip dan kegagalan.
- [Seeder](03-database/06-seeder.md) — `id: database-seeder`.
  `Seeder::add()`, kontrak file tanpa arah, perintah `db:seed`, log `seed`,
  skip.

## Referensi

- [`Selvi\Framework`](99-referensi/01-framework.md) — `id: ref-framework`.
  `Framework::run()`.
- [`Selvi\Routing\Route`](99-referensi/02-route.md) — `id: ref-route`.
  Pendaftaran route, grup, middleware, `match()`.
- [`Selvi\Input\Request`](99-referensi/03-request.md) — `id: ref-request`.
  Pembaca method, get, post, raw, header, file, cookie, route.
- [`Selvi\Output\Response`](99-referensi/04-response.md) — `id: ref-response`.
  Status code, cookie, `send()`, helper `response()`.
- [`Selvi\Output\JsonResponse`](99-referensi/05-json-response.md) —
  `id: ref-json-response`. Data, opsi JSON, helper `jsonResponse()`.
- [`Selvi\View`](99-referensi/06-view.md) — `id: ref-view`. `addPath()`,
  `setVar()`, `render()`, `include()`, helper `view()`.
- [`Selvi\Controller`](99-referensi/07-controller.md) — `id: ref-controller`.
  Base class opsional.
- [`Selvi\Data\DataObject`](99-referensi/14-data-object.md) —
  `id: ref-data-object`. `of()`, `toArray()`, aturan pemetaan.
- [`Selvi\Data\DataProperty`](99-referensi/15-data-property.md) —
  `id: ref-data-property`. Attribute properti: `name`, `prefix`, `optional`,
  `cast`, `serialize`.
- [`Selvi\Database\Manager`](99-referensi/08-manager.md) — `id: ref-manager`.
  Registry koneksi: `add()`, `get()`, `default()`, `has()`.
- [`Selvi\Database\DB`](99-referensi/09-db.md) — `id: ref-db`.
  Facade `connection()`, `table()`, `schema()`.
- [`Selvi\Database\Builder\DDL\SchemaBuilder`](99-referensi/10-schema-builder.md)
  — `id: ref-schema-builder`. Eksekusi DDL dan pasangan `compile*()`.
- [`Selvi\Database\Builder\DDL\Blueprint`](99-referensi/11-blueprint.md) —
  `id: ref-blueprint`. Definisi kolom `create()`.
- [`Selvi\Database\Builder\DDL\AlterBlueprint`](99-referensi/12-alter-blueprint.md)
  — `id: ref-alter-blueprint`. Operasi `alter()`.
- [`Selvi\Database\Builder\DDL\Clauses\ColumnClause`](99-referensi/13-column-clause.md)
  — `id: ref-column-clause`. Modifier kolom.
- [`Selvi\Database\Builder\DML\QueryBuilder`](99-referensi/16-query-builder.md)
  — `id: ref-query-builder`. SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP, ORDER, LIMIT,
  INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.
- [`Selvi\Database\Interfaces\IResult`](99-referensi/17-hasil-query.md) —
  `id: ref-hasil-query`. `num_rows()`, `rows()`, `row()`, `result()`.
- [`Selvi\Database\Schema`](99-referensi/18-schema.md) — `id: ref-schema`.
  Handle DDL terikat koneksi untuk migrasi/seed.
- [`Selvi\Database\Migration`](99-referensi/19-migration.md) —
  `id: ref-migration`. Registry path, perintah `db:migrate`, aturan skip.
- [`Selvi\Database\Seeder`](99-referensi/20-seeder.md) — `id: ref-seeder`.
  Registry path, perintah `db:seed`, aturan skip.

## Belum ditulis

Model, relasi, dan konversi value menunggu refactor attribute Model selesai.
Halaman yang belum ada sengaja tidak ditautkan di sini.
